body:
Merged `origin/main` (6349a542e) into the branch to remove the conflicts. New head: `cf8878c44c32a4bac920a3aa96f5dddd0920f034` (old head: `ba987e7b4`).

Conflicting files:

- `crates/ui/src/actions.rs` (`ensure_field_view`): both sides changed the same refusal line. This PR changed only the text ("stock simulation refused: ... - the stock shows uncut"). Main (#2182, 82c5cf13c) changed the text and moved the line to `state.say_once` ("simulation shows the uncut stock: ..."). Main uses the same text at the second refusal site. Resolution: took main. The change is wording only. No logic or safety check is lost.
- `crates/ui/src/field_view_tests.rs` (`a_refused_playback_is_said_once_and_retired_with_the_transport`): the assert follows the text above. Resolution: took main.

No other hand edits. `git diff origin/main --stat` lists only the files of this PR. No CR line endings were added.

Note: the PR body and `docs/decisions/2280-sim-partial-playback.md` (lines 10-11) still name the old refusal text. The author must update them to the text of main, or drop that bullet.

Targeted gate (debug, `-j 6`):

- `camcraft-app` `--test stock_play_stop`: 7 passed, 1 ignored.
- `camcraft-app` `--test stock_play_precalc`: 3 passed.
- `camcraft-sim` `--test play_keys`: 4 passed.
- `camcraft-ui` `--lib` (includes `field_view_tests`, `play_precalc_tests`): 1046 passed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

GitHub reports MERGEABLE after the push. I removed the `conflicts` label.

ready for a re-check

Quick pass on `4b03d1f6a`: the PR merges cleanly with `main`. The author's targeted tests and clippy are green on `cf8878c44`; the commit after it changes one decision file only. The body is complete. I flag it ready for the delta review of the refresh.
